'''Cal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was part of the [[Wolf Squadron]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] unit during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Cal's squadron operated from the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Annamar]], hidden deep within a massive asteroid field near the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="TWODV" />
During the [[Battle of Annamar]], Cal fought against [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], firing on him with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. He and his squadron were all killed when Vader dropped a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] on the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] stationed in the base.<ref name="TWODV" />
